# Database Session Management

The function assumes the database session will always succeed without errors during execution. If session management fails, such as the database being unreachable or the session being improperly configured, the application may crash or behave unexpectedly.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.register_repository`
